d: In ancient Nabadwip, a devout ascetic seeking divinity meets a wealthy young woman longing for love and family, sparking a rare, unforgettable romance that changes lives.
Rahul agrees to marry Pallavi to fulfill his father's wish, but only as a contract. Their relationship takes an unexpected turn when Rahul meets with a life-changing accident.
Kamala, a resilient woman, safeguards her ancestral home while facing family conflicts, hidden secrets and emotional trials that test her courage, love and determination.
Kusum is a happy village girl. She loves to talk to her plant and goat. She wants to impress Indrani Ganguly. She will try hard to reach her goal, no matter what!
